reputation 0 iprep/reputation.list
# 'rule SID RULE', or 'refused SID RULE' when Suricata does not load it,
# then 'packet NS HEX SIDS': the packet's time in nanoseconds, its IP
# bytes and the sids that alerted on it, a sid once per alert, '-' for none,
# then 'end N SIDS': what alerted when flow N was flushed at the end of
# the capture, its last address byte being N, then 'proto N NAME': the
# application protocol Suricata logged for flow N.
rule 13000 alert udp any any -> any any (msg:"iprep 13000"; iprep:src,BadHosts,>,30;)
rule 13001 alert udp any any -> any any (msg:"iprep 13001"; iprep:dst,BadHosts,>,30;)
rule 13002 alert udp any any -> any any (msg:"iprep 13002"; iprep:any,BadHosts,>,30;)
rule 13003 alert udp any any -> any any (msg:"iprep 13003"; iprep:both,BadHosts,>,30;)
rule 13004 alert udp any any -> any any (msg:"iprep 13004"; iprep:src,BadHosts,<,20;)
rule 13005 alert udp any any -> any any (msg:"iprep 13005"; iprep:src,BadHosts,=,10;)
rule 13006 alert udp any any -> any any (msg:"iprep 13006"; iprep:src,Google,isset;)
rule 13007 alert udp any any -> any any (msg:"iprep 13007"; iprep:dst,Google,isset;)
rule 13008 alert udp any any -> any any (msg:"iprep 13008"; iprep:src,BadHosts,isnotset;)
rule 13009 alert udp any any -> any any (msg:"iprep 13009"; iprep:any,Unused,isset;)
rule 13010 alert udp any any -> any any (msg:"iprep 13010"; iprep:src,Google,=,0;)
refused 13011 alert udp any any -> any any (msg:"iprep 13011"; iprep:src,Nobody,>,1;)
rule 13012 alert udp any any -> any any (msg:"iprep 13012"; iprep:src,BadHosts,>,128;)

rule 13015 alert udp any any -> any any (msg:"iprep 13015"; iprep:src,BadHosts,>,60; iprep:src,Google,>,10;)
rule 13016 alert udp any any -> any any (msg:"iprep 13016"; iprep:src,BadHosts,<=,10;)
rule 13017 alert udp any any -> any any (msg:"iprep 13017"; iprep:src,BadHosts,!=,50;)
refused 13018 alert udp any any -> any any (msg:"iprep 13018"; iprep:src,BadHosts,40-60;)
rule 13019 alert udp any any -> any any (msg:"iprep 13019"; iprep:src,BadHosts,>,255;)
refused 13020 alert udp any any -> any any (msg:"iprep 13020"; iprep:src,BadHosts,>,256;)

refused 13022 alert udp any any -> any any (msg:"iprep 13022"; iprep:src,badhosts,>,1;)
refused 13023 alert udp any any -> any any (msg:"iprep 13023"; iprep:sideways,BadHosts,>,1;)
